notes.title: Vetrix Worlds is coming! 🥳
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/3c8aa45b1c3f3457530c827faea0b900121c0fdf.png

Get ready for the next chapter in the Vetrix series!

Vagabond is proud to announce Vetrix Worlds, the latest puzzle game in the beloved franchise.

As in the original game, players must match shapes in a three-dimensional space, but with some exciting new twists.

Vetrix Worlds features improved graphics and new gameplay mechanics, including a new campaign mode that will take you around the world, two multiplayer modes (versus and co-op), new block types, new power-ups, a new arcade mode, and more...

Vetrix Worlds will soon be available in Early Access and we can't wait to get your feedback!

Are you ready to take on the challenge of Vetrix Worlds? Get ready to put your puzzle-solving skills to the test!

Wishlist now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992860/Vetrix_Worlds/

notes.title: New Game Mode for Vetrix!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're adding new stuff to the game! :)

- A new "Free Mode"! That allows you to play without any time constraints, and has its own new 8-bit music track! 
- More languages! French, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
- Two new color palettes! See the image below to discover which palettes won our Discord poll.
- Some quality of life changes.

This new update is based on your feedback and we hope you'll like it.
Thank you so much for supporting the game! <3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/4a8477bd155e3c2cdeedc4ddc534da141341cd7c.png

notes.title: It's time for a surprise update! 😎
notes.content:
Hello, my lovely little pixels! 😁

With Vetrix reaching new markets, we're adding new stuff to the game!

- New "Free Mode"!
That allows you to play without any time constraints, and has its own new dope 8-bit music track!

- More languages!
French, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese (and Korean shortly after).

- And of course, two new color palettes!
That you can vote for by joining our Discord at the link below!
https://discord.gg/VtzJPaA

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/05250c5bba519cf3392e7ddea8feb5a77171a535.png

The update will be live by the end of the month. 😉
